title: Credit Builder Accounts Early Closing: Interest Days for the Period Before the Oldest Unpaid Due Date
content:
At an early closing of a Credit Builder account the closing interest runs over a number of interest days: a count for the period before the account's oldest unpaid due date, plus the calendar days after that due date up to and including the closing date, the total never below zero. The count for the period before the oldest unpaid due date is set as follows.

## Day count

- When the most recent debit card payment credited toward the oldest unpaid due date has not been returned (no return points at that payment, whether a chargeback, code CB, or any other return), that payment has paid the installment's interest and the interest days count no month before the oldest unpaid due date; when two were posted on the same day, the one booked first counts as the most recent.
- When there is no such debit card payment and two or more whole monthly payments are past due, the interest days count, in place of the 30 days for the month before the oldest unpaid due date, 30 days for each whole monthly payment the account shows past due (the amount past due divided by the monthly payment, rounded down), the oldest unpaid installment included.
- When neither is the case, the interest days count 30 days for the month before the oldest unpaid due date.

"No such debit card payment" covers an account with no debit card payment credited toward the oldest unpaid due date and an account whose most recent such payment has been returned. The oldest unpaid due date is the next due date the account shows; the amount past due and the monthly payment are read from the account record.

| Most recent debit card payment toward the oldest unpaid due date | Whole monthly payments past due | Days counted before that due date |
|---|---|---|
| exists, no return points at it | any | 0 |
| none, or it has been returned | 2 or more | 30 for each whole monthly payment past due |
| none, or it has been returned | fewer than 2 | 30 |

## Hypothetical figures

| Account | Days before the oldest unpaid due date |
|---|---|
| a debit card payment toward that due date, not returned | 0 |
| no debit card payment; amount past due 250.00, monthly payment 100.00 (2 whole payments) | 60 |
| no debit card payment; amount past due 310.00, monthly payment 100.00 (3 whole payments) | 90 |
| its only debit card payment was charged back; amount past due 100.00, monthly payment 100.00 | 30 |
| two debit card payments toward that due date on the same day: the first booked was returned, the second was not | the first booked counts as the most recent; it was returned, so 30 or 30 per whole payment past due as above |
